summary: OCHA reports more than 220 olive trees vandalized in six incidents and additional settler property/livestock damage in twelve incidents.
discovery_sources: OCHA Protection of Civilians 14-27 Mar 2023; canonical ILPV-2023-0322; canonical ILPV-2023-0324
resolution_notes: Unitization advanced without creating duplicates. The Mar. 17 Husan tree-vandalism component is already canonical ILPV-2023-0322; PCHR, WAFA and PLO NAD identify about 50 trees plus retaining-wall/fence damage, and OCHA independently places Husan in this Mar. 14-27 tree-vandalism lane. The mid-March Yasuf/As-Sawiya component is already canonical ILPV-2023-0324; NAD/WAFA identify about 170 trees with a Mar. 14/15 date discrepancy, and OCHA independently places As Sawiya in this lane. These are linked aggregate components, not new incidents. Remaining tree-vandalism/locality components (including Burin, Sinjil, Al Ganoub/Halhul and Deir Istiya as applicable) plus the residual twelve property/livestock incidents still require event-level matching; MAR23-016 therefore remains Unresolved.
media_status: No new exact incident media recovered. The two linked canonical components have no safely exact media; no generic, later or merely related imagery was substituted.
